heading: When your internet goes down, have a backup plan.
intro: TekNeek Connect is managed cellular backup internet for businesses that depend on connectivity. It's a backup for your primary connection, not a replacement for it.

steps.title: 1. Primary Internet
steps.description: Your existing service handles normal business traffic.

steps.title: 2. Automatic Failover
steps.description: Compatible equipment can switch essential traffic to cellular backup after a primary outage.

steps.title: 3. Managed Monitoring
steps.description: Remote monitoring helps identify issues and manage the service.

steps.title: 4. Automatic Recovery
steps.description: Traffic can return to primary service according to the configured policy when service recovers.

businessDescription: Gateway setup, firewall integration, failover testing, and optional static IP service are tailored to your site.
notice: Cellular coverage, speed, data allowance, application compatibility, and availability vary by site, carrier, plan, and equipment. Backup capacity may be limited to essential operations.
